rules.scope: resolve a physically numeric low-cardinality field as a query-local measure when an explicit aggregate operation binds to that field and no local grouping cue binds to it
rules.rationale: Schema semantic type and query role are distinct. A global by/across cue must not convert an aggregate operand into a grouping dimension when the cue locally modifies another field.
rules.failure_condition: A numeric aggregate operand is treated as a dimension because an unrelated grouping cue exists elsewhere in the query.
rules.conflict_policy: Explicit operator-to-field binding outranks global grouping evidence; local grouping evidence on the same field blocks promotion; non-numeric fields are never promoted.
